summary: Minimal PLATE Issue states (#556): add status:implemented label; workflow step that marks linked issues on merge to release-* branches (distinguishes implemented-in-RC from released-to-main); surface notes + AGENTS/persona updates. Enables tracking work landed on release branches before final Release PR.
migration_impact: Downstream repos get a status:implemented label and automatic labeling on release-branch merges for Features/Bugs. Issues now have clearer lifecycle: open -> implemented (on release merge) -> closed/released (on main merge + tag). Update any custom queries or dashboards.
migration_guidance: 1. Sync the new status:implemented label (or let bootstrap create it on next apply).
2. The pr-issue-link-check (or equivalent) will auto-apply the label on merges to your release branches.
3. Use gh issue list --label status:implemented or gh plate epic status to see RC-ready work.
4. When the final Release PR merges to main, the issues will naturally close via their original Closes links.
agent_notes: When all children for an Epic are merged to the epic/ or release branch, they become 'implemented'. The final epic-close PR to main releases them. Use in planning: plate_epic_status will surface the distinction over time. Update release ceremony comments to reference the state.
